scope.developer_blinding: last2years labels not used in new design code; underlying raw quotes already exist and prior research examined recent markets, so not a pristine untouched holdout

sources.selection: parent package1 common-core candidate dates, never broader history for M0; exact common model dates per horizon
sources.night: TAIFEX TX monthly positive-volume complete OHLC, nearest eligible monthly contract and same-contract prior regular close; do not splice continuous contracts; keep114 roll records
sources.US: TSM,SOX,SPX from sealed Yahoo daily raw; NASDAQ descriptive only
sources.fx: CBC official, previous published observation only; Yahoo TWD=X excluded from predictive inputs
sources.vix: Cboe daily CLOSE on exact latest reference US equity session; do not infer equity trading calendar from VIX extra holiday observations; Yahoo VIX diagnostic only
sources.stock2330: parent Yahoo raw with7 verified TWSE overlays, for parity description and source qualification, not direct primary directional feature
sources.corrections: old raw and official overlays retained separately, no performance-based fill or source choice
sources.on_new_missing_input: all3models excluded on same date from paired research comparison; in live withhold conditional probability and show explicit reference/missing state, not zero-risk substitute

source_evidence_limit.US_calendar: sealed parent reconstructed holiday rules+known national mourning exceptions, crosschecked4price series; complete original historical notice archive unavailable
source_evidence_limit.early_close: use16:00ET as conservative latest regular close bound, do not claim exact historical early-close timestamp
source_evidence_limit.US_daily_available_bound: max(actual_regular_close_bound, source_date+1calendar day08:00Asia/Taipei); assumed delivery bound, not actual archived release time
source_evidence_limit.CBC_available_bound: source date17:00Asia/Taipei; pre2019 rule extrapolated from current2019 FAQ
source_evidence_limit.night_available_bound: actual preceding TAIFEX regular day15:00 to next calendar day05:00; daily data lacks actual last-trade timestamps; no false exact05:00transaction claim
source_evidence_limit.adjustments: use sealed vendor close, not adjclose; dividend dates retained for diagnostics, no total-return substitution for cash-price target; no split events in sealed2016+TSM/2330 feed; any new split/ratio discrepancy requires a new input version before use
source_evidence_limit.promotion_limit: historical pass permits retrospective research recommendation only; production requires later implementation seal and genuinely timestamped prospective observations

events.decision_at: D08:30Asia/Taipei; D is next actual TW cash session after anchor t
events.anchor: fixed previous actual cash close C[t]
events.target_end: h-th actual cash session starting atD; target index index(D)+h-1
events.up: terminal close >= original C[t]; exact ties included
events.index: TAIEX cash price index OHLC, not TX, not a total-return index
events.calendar: use sealed observed official cash sessions including historical Saturday trading; prospective calendar notices/version required; never infer a closure from missing quote
events.no_rebase: original anchor and target stay fixed during revisions; no replacing target by a new3-day date

split.basis: decision_date not US date or prior cash anchor date
split.purge: label target_end must be <= own split label_cutoff; rows crossing a boundary are excluded, never recycled into the next cohort
split.same_dates: M0/M1/M2 share identical eligible decision dates within each horizon; h1/h2/h3 can differ only by label maturity and fixed gates; do not compare raw horizon scores as if targets equal
split.embargo: no additional gap needed beyond maturity purge for fixed fit; every train target matures before calibration begins and every calibration target before test begins
split.primary_fit: one final fit train2017-2023 and calibration2023-2024, then fixed weights/standardization/calibrator for the entire2year test
split.no_test_refit: no periodic refitting, test-label learning, hyperparameter tuning or recalibration during primary sealed test; future rolling-refit study needs a new version
split.holdout_description: 2024-11-06..2026-11-05 sealed retrospective test, not virgin data; last dates per horizon purged for maturity
split.test_opening: Only authorized package5; package4 must first seal initial AND revision implementation, dependencies, training/calibration data manifests and this parent protocol SHA. No model/test opening command exists in package2.

sigma.purpose: scale known price moves, not mechanically assign direction

M1.source: same monthly TX contract; previous actual regular session t; night attributed toD
scheduled completed session-end bound; not actual last-trade age, whose historical timestamp is absent

M2_extra.source: accumulate all US sessions after prior Taiwan cash information cutoff; USD price return
CBC publication bound17:00Taipei; never same-morning future daily close
Cboe primary; exact latest reference NYSE session; closed-market extra VIX dates not substituted

M2_extra.formula: count(US sessions whose regular close_bound>night_session_end_bound and availability_bound<=decision_at)
M2_extra.source: known old-night age and additional overseas sessions; not target returns

features.transforms: float64; standardize each feature using training-only population mean/std(ddof0); std<=1e-12 -> fixed zero feature and record it; no winsorization/feature selection/SMOTE/class reweighting
features.normal_vs_reopening: same formula accumulates multi-session US change; night age and sessions after last night remain explicit; no 4-calendar-day stale exclusion for a legitimate holiday closure
features.ADR_parity: 5ordinary/ADR and CBC conversion may be shown as descriptive parity with source limitation; absolute premium or current ratio backcast does not enter primary model; use new USD return to avoid treating an old premium as new bullish information
no_unregistered_inputs: foreign/retail models trained on later years

M0.data: admitted training+calibration cohorts for same feature-qualified dates; boundary-purged rows stay excluded
M0.formula: p_up=(up_count+0.5)/(n+1), Jeffreys smoothing; fixed through test
M0.calibration: none separately; no alternative recent/full-history baseline selection

M2.type: same L2 logistic using M1+6overseas features

fit.failure: nonconvergence/nonfinite values -> model ineligible, no solver retry or hyperparameter patch

calibrator.type: positive-slope sigmoid on raw model logits, fit only calibration cohort
calibrator.library: scipy L-BFGS-B, same tolerances as logistic; slope lower bound0
calibrator.constant_logits: if population std(logits)<=1e-12, freeze a=1 and optimize only b under same objective

minimum_samples.failure: no lowered threshold; absent gate means not qualified

probabilities.apply: after calibration or M0 frequency; same final clip for every model
archive: final clipped full-precision p_up and p_down
probabilities.scoring: use actual full-precision clipped published probability for both Brier and logloss; raw numbers diagnostic only
probabilities.display: 0.1% largest-remainder two-class rounding sum100%; never grade rounded output
probabilities.outcome_not_capped: 0/1 realized event after maturity is outcome, not a clipped future prediction
probabilities.price_interval_policy: Initial logistic models predict binary direction only, not a conditional median/80%price interval. Existing unconditional price ranges must remain explicitly historical reference, not relabeled as new conditional ranges or rescaled by p.

metrics.legacy_warning: two-class sum Brier is twice this; old3class RPS/Brier and risk/trade win-rate are not comparable
metrics.log_loss: mean(-y*log(p)-(1-y)*log(1-p)), natural logarithm, same clipped probability
metrics.log_loss_guard: candidate mean test logloss <= each simpler model mean logloss for an upgrade; noninferiority point guard, not a claim of statistically significant logloss gain
secondary: ROC AUC with constant predictor AUC0.5 if both classes
metrics.small_bins: show counts and small-sample warning; do not merge after seeing results or claim calibrated
metrics.no_secondary_override: no promoting a failed Brier candidate by AUC, PnL, logloss or a favorable subgroup
metrics.gap_vs_intraday: h1 only: after test unseal, decompose log(C_D/C_t)=log(O_D/C_t)+log(C_D/O_D). Report correlation and covariance of fixed full-target logit(p) with each component and their exact covariance sum; no extra predictive fit. Full-close probabilities are NOT calibrated probabilities of gap/intraday signs; no segment Brier substitution or additive Brier decomposition. Diagnostic only, no adoption override.
subgroups: night-age and DST-transition metadata only; no selecting best subgroup

inference.family: 3 ordered model-pair comparisons times3 horizons; not old12 hypotheses
inference.loss_difference: candidate Brier loss minus simpler Brier loss on same dates; lower is better
inference.master_grid: all official test decision sessions, retain missing/ineligible dates as NaN; do not compress gaps
inference.bootstrap: paired stationary bootstrap (geometric restart probability1/L) on master grid; same resampled indices across all9 comparisons; average only finite paired losses
inference.ci: two-sided nominal95% percentile CI for each paired mean difference, not simultaneous coverage
inference.p_value: one-sided centered bootstrap p=(1+count(mean(d_star-dbar)<=dbar))/(B+1); invalid test assigned p=1
inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down across9initial-forecast tests at family alpha0.025; reserve alpha0.025 for9prespecified revision comparisons. Union-bound overall familywise alpha<=0.05 across the two families; no claim that each separate0.05 family yields global0.05.
inference.DM: supplement only, HAC Bartlett lag=h-1 on actual session grid; optional lag2/5 sensitivities prelisted, never an adoption selector

conditions: mean relative Brier reduction >=1% versus each simpler
main L10 nominal95% difference CI upper<0
Holm adjusted p<0.025 across9 initial comparisons
L5 and L20 nominal95% difference CI upper<0
mean logloss no higher than each simpler
adoption.M2: must pass M2-M0 and M2-M1; M1 itself need not be selected but M1 must be fit/score eligible as a comparator
adoption.failure: keep highest eligible simpler level; no default release of original V6 by omission
adoption.research_not_live: historical selection is a retrospective recommendation only; no production activation in packages2-6

revisions.scope: package6 research, second prespecified9-test family alpha0.025, separately reported; initial9family also alpha0.025, total global FWER<=0.05
revisions.fixed_event: same root_id+original anchor+original target date throughout
comparators: R0 frozen prior probability without revision
R1 mechanistic: observed movement from original anchor + zero-drift residual return distribution scaled by remaining volatility
R2 R1 plus new registered overnight/overseas directional inputs fitted with pretest data
revisions.R1_definition: For remaining r=1 or2: train-only log remaining returns/ (sqrt(r)*prior_sigma); subtract their training mean to obtain centered empirical F0. At update P_up=1-F0(threshold^-), threshold=log(original_anchor/current_completed_cash_close)/(sqrt(r)*current_sigma); equality belongs to up. Reference samples need complete labels by training cutoff. No directional calibrator for R1; final clamp only.
revisions.R2_definition: Same F0 and threshold, shifted by ridge prediction mu_z of standardized remaining log return from same10registered current features. Fit one ridge per r, training-only feature standardization; objective mean((z_return-intercept-Xbeta)**2)+0.01*sum(beta**2), intercept unpenalized; deterministic closed-form ridge/linear solve. P_up_raw=1-F0((threshold-mu_z)^-).
revisions.calibration: R2 only: same positive-slope sigmoid formula as initial models, separately by original-horizon/stage on held-out pretest calibration roots. For logit use raw CDF probability clipped1e-9..1-1e-9 numerically, then final probability clip1..99. R1 remains zero-drift mechanical and R0 remains initial saved value.
revisions.phase6_adoption: 3pairs(R1-R0,R2-R0,R2-R1) x3cases(H2remaining1,H3remaining2,H3remaining1)=9; same1%/block CI/logloss rules, Holm across9at alpha0.025. R2 must beat BOTH comparators. Fit/source/root qualification required. Failing initialM2 eligibility blocks conditional revision deployment, not descriptive tracking.
revisions.manual_selection_bias: primary evaluation uses fixed08:30stages on full paired historical grid; manual irregular request days reported separately, never pretend random sample
diagnostics: mean delta_p with paired block interval
correlation consecutive revisions on same H3root, same target and anchor
differences versus mechanical R1 not just versus frozen R0
revisions.martingale_note: ideal coherent conditional probabilities at fixed information times have zero-mean, orthogonal increments; estimates/manual selection/overlapping targets can deviate. Diagnostic confidence intervals, not a hard zero-pass requirement
revisions.one_month: 2026-10-06..2026-11-05 decision dates, only mature target endpoints; a descriptive subset of already sealed test, opened only after full primary test code frozen, never used for tuning
revisions.path: no27-path probability multiplication or invented candle-shape match
revisions.R0_definition: original M2 initial probability for the same root, horizon, anchor and target, frozen unchanged; not a favorable test-selected initial model
revisions.deployment_root_gate: formal revision rollout limited to new initial-M2 roots for horizons where M2 itself qualifies for initial deployment; do not silently apply evidence to old M0/M1/three-class roots
revisions.dedup_mean_fit: deduplicate conditional-mean/distribution fitting rows by(current_decision_date,remaining_r,target_end), not repeat a one-day target just because multiple original roots share it; assessment still retains distinct fixed events byroot/stage
revisions.code_before_test: implementation for both initial and revision studies must be sealed in package4 before opening any shared sealed-test labels in package5; package6 may execute/diagnose frozen revision design but cannot invent a fresh untouched test after initial scores were seen.
revisions.paired_stage_grid: use original root-decision official session grid, not compressed manual update dates; each stage requires both initial and current08:30core-source qualification plus target maturity; preserve missing grid dates for bootstrap
revisions.diagnostics_definition: On paired complete H3roots: delta1=p_R2_rem2-p_M2_initial; delta2=p_R2_rem1-p_R2_rem2. Report each mean and Pearson corr(delta1,delta2) across roots; root-date paired stationary block intervals, minimum30roots for correlation. Do not call corr across unrelated root updates consecutive-revision orthogonality.

prospective_and_rollback.activation: later authorized package8 only, after historical recommendation and package4 implementation seal; no endpoint or HTTP auto-publish
prospective_and_rollback.cutoff: inputs available<=D08:30; qualified issue time D08:30..08:44:59Taipei; actual saved_at never backdated; earlier captures/context after08:45 shown separately and not counted as08:30 prospective predictions
prospective_and_rollback.manual_only: only human chat instruction creates snapshots; GET, refresh, schedule do not make or revise decisions
prospective_and_rollback.unique_key: one first eligible prediction per version/decision-date/horizon; later same-cutoff duplicates not extra samples; root revisions separately counted
prospective_and_rollback.forward_condition: after minimums, candidate point Brier must improve >=1% and mean logloss must not exceed each eligible simpler on same qualified observations; retrospective adoption gates remain necessary; minimum60 is not a proof of statistical skill
prospective_and_rollback.monitor: on each chat update after new outcomes are mature, review last60qualified paired initial forecasts per active horizon; no mutation on page read
prospective_and_rollback.rollback_performance: if active model rolling60Brier > same-date M0 rolling60Brier, suspend that horizon model; this is an operating safeguard not a new significance claim
prospective_and_rollback.fallback: highest historically+prospectively qualified simpler whose same60point Brier and logloss do not exceed M0; otherwise show M0 explicitly as historical reference
prospective_and_rollback.source_or_integrity_failure: withhold conditional probability immediately, preserve last dated forecast; do not assume missing=safe
prospective_and_rollback.restoration: at least60new mature qualified paired predictions since suspension and same forward/old historical requirements; no next-day automatic return, no test-driven retraining
prospective_and_rollback.trading: forecast research does not modify V6/V6-2 score65,8% limit,0/2day cooldowns or orders

reproducibility.current_code_seal: this package design/count/policy test code and actual environment, all hashed
reproducibility.future_model_implementation: Not written/fitted here; package4 must seal both initial and revision implementation with dependencies+training data+parent protocol SHA before ANY package5test opening; adding/revising a model later requires new version and cannot claim shared test untouched.
